title: a nested feature typed by a definition declared LATER in the same package
note: DEFECT FOUND BY THIS CAMPAIGN. This model is valid SysML v2 — order of declaration within a package is not significant — yet a nested feature whose type is declared later in the same package does not resolve, and the agent is told its correct model has unresolved types. The project's own examples/vehicle.sysml is written in exactly this order and reports 6 such errors. Moving the definitions above their use (see fixed.sysml) resolves them, which is the workaround, not the fix. See docs/AGENT-TEXT-CAMPAIGN.md "Open defects".
